question: Who spoke this teaching and in which text was it revealed?
premises: The Blessed Lord himself spoke the teaching.
He spoke it in the glorious Kula secret text.
That text bears true names grounded in the unity of power and its holder.
inference: The doctrine of the poison-principle is transmitted by the Lord in the Kula scripture where names reflect the unity of Śakti and Śaktimat.
uncertainties: The exact title or identity of the 'śrīmatkulaguhkara' text is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The Blessed Lord himself spoke this in the glorious Kula secret, a text whose names are truly meaningful because they arise from the unity of Power and the Possessor of Power.
